notes: Rad Power's commercial fleet eBikes are based on the RadRunner utility platform: a 750 W geared rear-hub motor, 672 Wh (48 V, 14 Ah) removable battery, 180 mm mechanical disc brakes, and a 145 kg (320 lb) payload capacity on reinforced 12-gauge-spoke 20-inch wheels. Rad Fleet variants add telematics, heavy-duty racks, and swap-friendly shared battery packs, targeting delivery and last-mile logistics operators.

failure_modes.name: Battery pack capacity fade / cell degradation
failure_modes.symptoms: Sharply reduced range, voltage sag under load, premature low-battery cutouts
failure_modes.mitigation: Track cycle counts per pack, rotate packs across fleet, retire below 70% state-of-health

failure_modes.name: Mechanical disc brake pad wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Grinding noise, reduced stopping power under cargo load, lever pull to grip
failure_modes.mitigation: Pad inspection every 500 km in delivery duty, rotor replacement when below min thickness

failure_modes.name: Chain/drivetrain stretch under cargo load
failure_modes.symptoms: Chain skipping, drops, noisy tensioner, worn sprocket teeth
failure_modes.mitigation: Chain wear gauge checks, lubrication schedule, replace chain and 16T sprocket as a set

failure_modes.name: Controller/connector water ingress
failure_modes.symptoms: Error codes, cutting out in rain, throttle/PAS dropouts
failure_modes.mitigation: Dielectric grease, inspect underslung controller box seals, reroute or sleeve exposed harness sections

failure_modes.name: GPS/fleet telematics unit failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Bike missing from fleet dashboard, failed remote lock, stale location data
failure_modes.mitigation: Watchdog reboot firmware, hardwire power feed check, swap telematics module

failure_modes.name: Spoke fatigue / wheel out-of-true
failure_modes.symptoms: Wobble at speed, broken spokes under heavy payload, brake rub
failure_modes.mitigation: Tension-check 12-gauge spokes at service intervals, enforce payload limits, retrue or rebuild wheels
